propositions: pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 + anthropic 0.120.2 causes AnthropicModel import to fail because the older pydantic-ai-slim does not recognize anthropic types renamed in newer SDK versions

uv's universal resolution locks all extras jointly, causing boto3 version constraints from inspect-ai's dependency chain to conflict with pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]'s requirement, forcing pydantic-ai-slim downgrade below 1.107
pip-based installs succeed because they resolve one extra set at a time without cross-extra conflicts, while uv provisioned environments experience the resolution downgrade
declaring [tool.uv] conflicts between eval+bedrock and eval+dev extras allows uv to resolve pydantic-ai-slim>=1.107 + anthropic 0.120.2 correctly
floor bump to pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries]>=1.107 with uv conflicts block repairs the import breakage in uv-provisioned environments while maintaining pip compatibility
